data.name: Raman
data.gender_notes: Raman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'R-M-N', meaning 'a shining light' or 'a beacon'. The name Raman carries the meaning “A radiant light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Raman usually hope their child will grow to embody a radiant light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Raman can also be understood as a reminder of Allah's light and guidance in our lives.
data.etymology: Raman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A radiant light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raman total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رمان
in_arabic.meaning: ثمر النخل، الحب الذي يرمى في القلوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: رمان هو اسم مشتق من الكلمة العربية 'رمانة' التي تعني ثمر النخل. ويرمز الاسم إلى الحب الذي يرمى في القلوب، ويعتبر من الأسماء الجميلة التي تعبر عن الحب والجمال. وقد ورد ذكر الرمان في القرآن الكريم في سورة الرحمن، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَالرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَابِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَابِهٍ'.

in_urdu.name: رمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: رمان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے عشق، محبت، یا ثمر درخت کھجور۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر ہندوستان اور پاکستان میں۔ رمان نام کا انتخاب کرنے والے والدین اپنے بچے کے لیے محبت اور جوش کی علامت چاہتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रमण
in_hindi.meaning: प्रेम, प्यार, खजूर के पेड़ का फल
in_hindi.long_meaning: रमण एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो प्रेम, प्यार, और खजूर के पेड़ के फल को दर्शाता है। यह नाम हिंदू और मुस्लिम दोनों समुदायों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है। रमण नाम के व्यक्ति को प्रेम और सहानुभूति की भावना से परिपूर्ण माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: رمان
in_pashto.long_meaning: رمان د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې د مينه، میړه، يا د خرماګانو میوه معنی لري. دا نوم د پښتنو په کلتور کې ډیر مشهور دی او د مینې او جوش د نښې په توګه کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Raman
in_english.long_meaning: Raman is an Arabic name that originates from the word 'rumman', meaning date palm fruit. It symbolizes love, affection, and beauty. The name Raman is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Ar-Rahman. In Islamic tradition, Raman represents a person with a loving and compassionate personality. The name is popular across various Muslim cultures, including South Asia, the Middle East, and Turkey.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raman holds great cultural significance, especially within Islamic communities. Historically, many great scholars, artists, and leaders have been named Raman as a symbol of their enlightening influence on their society. It is a name synonymous with brilliance, wisdom, and innovation, reflecting the high value placed on knowledge and intellectual pursuits within Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Raman serves as a reminder of the divine light within each individual, illuminating the path towards personal growth and enlightenment. It is a name that encourages one to be a beacon of light in their own way, shining forth the truth and wisdom given to them by Allah. As such, Raman is not only an honorable name but also a constant inspiration to live a life that is a source of guidance and illumination for others.
